purpose: Deterministic infrastructure feasibility test; not agent-autonomy evidence

workflow_selector.expected_objective: Verify that submitting a search query using the top search bar successfully navigates to the search results page and displays matching results.

manual_repair.description: Remove the JavaScript parse blocker, then wire the existing top search box to render matching videos and update the SPA route; the frozen implementation exposes the controls and search helper but attaches no submit handler.
